bio.text: Sharon Henderson was elected to the Georgia House of Representatives in 2020, was sworn in on January 11, 2021, and represents House District 113, which includes a portion of Newton County.

According to her legislative biography, Henderson is a native of Goose Creek, South Carolina, who entered the ministry as pastor of New Bethel Love Center in Summerville, South Carolina, and became a bishop in 2005.

The biography says she worked in banking and finance for more than 30 years and holds an associate degree from Trident Technical College and a Bachelor of Science in organizational management from Charleston Southern University.
